children: Apple's progress on product durability is drawing attention alongside the company's new A20 Pro chip and foldable-screen software. According to Sina Finance, the second-generation Ceramic Shield display glass was first used in the iPhone 17 series and also appeared on the iPhone 18 Pro this year, delivering the promised threefold improvement in scratch resistance.

The iPhone Duo, due out next month, includes several durability features, including IP68 protection. According to Sina Finance, Apple's new hardware engineering vice president, Tom Maribou, discussed the designs for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo during a group interview at the company's London headquarters, saying he was especially proud of the iPhone Duo hinge's durability.

title: Apple Hardware Chief Discusses iPhone Duo Hinge Durability and Ceramic Shield Reliability
